an3.4:1.1: tīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bālo veditabbo
an3.4:1.3: accayaṃ accayato na passati accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ na paṭikkaroti parassa kho pana accayaṃ desentassa yathādhammaṃ na paṭiggaṇhāti
an3.4:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bālo veditabbo.
an3.4:2.1: tīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito veditabbo
an3.4:2.3: accayaṃ accayato passati accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikkaroti parassa kho pana accayaṃ desentassa yathādhammaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti
an3.4:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito veditabboti. 5
